title: Finite closed-cover resolution with its actual adjunction augmentation
statement:
Let $X$ be a scheme [def-pc-scheme] and $A$ a sheaf of commutative rings on its small pro-etale site [def-weil-pbc-proetale-site]. Use module sheaves [def-weil-sheaf-of-modules-category] with rings obtained by inverse image [def-weil-proetale-inverse-image], and ordinary derived categories [def-weil-abstract-derived-category]. Let $i:Z\hookrightarrow X$ be a closed immersion [def-weil-closed-immersion] and let $Z_1,\ldots,Z_m\hookrightarrow X$, $m\geq1$, be closed immersions factoring through $Z$ whose underlying closed subsets cover $Z$. Assume every $X\setminus Z$ and $X\setminus Z_a$ is a quasi-compact open. For $\varnothing\ne J\subseteq\{1,\ldots,m\}$ let $Z_J=\bigcap_{a\in J}Z_a$ be the scheme-theoretic intersection and $i_J:Z_J\hookrightarrow X$ its inclusion. Use the actual closed adjunction units and exact closed direct images [lem-weil-pbc-proetale-ringed-open-closed].
For every bounded-below complex $K$ of $A$-module sheaves, the alternating closed-restriction complex has a natural augmented quasi-isomorphism
$$i_*i^*K\longrightarrow\left[\bigoplus_{|J|=1}i_{J,*}i_J^*K\longrightarrow\bigoplus_{|J|=2}i_{J,*}i_J^*K\longrightarrow\cdots\longrightarrow i_{\{1,\ldots,m\},*}i_{\{1,\ldots,m\}}^*K\right].$$
The bracket denotes the finite total complex with the singleton term in horizontal degree zero; its differential is the signed sum of the actual restriction units for $J\subset J\cup\{a\}$. Its augmentation composed with $K\to i_*i^*K$ is exactly the direct sum of the units $K\to i_{a,*}i_a^*K$. This is an identification in the derived category, natural in $K$, refinements of a finite ordered closed covering, and pullbacks for which the closed-restriction comparison maps are identified. In particular it is compatible with automorphisms of such diagrams, including parameterized diagrams. No assertion that the $Z_a\to Z$ form a covering of the pro-etale site is made.
